title: 3 GitHub Repos That Replace $500/Month of AI Tools
category: Open Source AI Tools & Autonomous Agents

repos.name: OpenHands (formerly OpenDevin)
keyFeatures: Writes code, debugs, and runs unit tests
Includes CLI + Web GUI + Cloud + Enterprise setups
Used by engineers at Netflix, Amazon, and TikTok

repos.name: Dify
repos.replaces: Langflow, Pinecone & full AI SaaS backend stack
keyFeatures: Visual workflow builder for LLM apps and agents
Supports any LLM model provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, local models)
Zero subscription full AI application development platform

repos.name: LibreChat
repos.replaces: ChatGPT Plus + Claude Pro + Gemini Advanced subscriptions ($60+/month)
keyFeatures: Unified chat interface for all LLM models (Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5/2.0, Mistral, Ollama/Local)
Web Search & custom plugins / MCP tools support
